tools.name: find_drills
tools.description: For parents, coaches and trainers (adults). Free SSTracker drills open at a child's age (the app's own age gates: contact, tackling, heading and advanced drills wait for their age), each with steps, minutes, a safety line and its page link.

tools.name: get_practice_plan
tools.description: For parents, coaches and trainers (adults). SSTracker's free team practice plan (two 60-minute practices) for a sport and U age group, with the page link.

tools.name: get_tryout_prep
tools.description: For parents, coaches and trainers (adults). SSTracker's free, calm three-week tryout-prep plan at home for a sport and age band, with the printable packet link.

tools.name: weekly_home_plan
tools.description: For parents, coaches and trainers (adults). A short general home week for a sport and age, kept inside SSTracker's youth limits (training days and session length for the age, two rest days a week), with a link to build a child's own week on SSTracker.
